name: let the lights bleed
source:
At this moment, you don't want [i]me[/i]. Did you ever want [i]me[/i]? Or is it all just about my body?

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/let-the-lights-bleed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
此刻，你想要的不是[i]我[/i]。你有哪一刻真心想要过[i]我[/i]吗？还是说，你要的从来都只是我的身体？

［摘自[url=https://naarel.itch.io/let-the-lights-bleed]itch.io[/url]］
